item.title: Striking school bus drivers in West Nipissing remain on picket line with no talks on the go
item.description: It's week two of the strike by school bus drivers working for Alouette Bus Lines and there are no talks going on between the two sides

item.title: North Bay Battalion lose at home to OHL's cellar-dwellers as Oshawa wins 4-3
item.description: After winning 8 of 9 the North Bay Battalion lost at home to the Ontario Hockey League's last place Oshawa Generals. A defeat that may prove very costly when the regular season is complete

item.title: The coming of spring means pothole season in North Bay
item.description: Motorists report potholes across the city, but one on Lakeshore Drive is particularly hazardous.

item.title: Canadore needs to find $20 million in savings; voluntary retirement packages offered
item.description: Canadore College “must” find $20 million in savings in the next fiscal year, and start they’re offering voluntary retirement packages to staff. The college issued a media release Friday morning informing students, staff and the public of the “unprecedented shift in the post-secondary landscape” and the required comprehensive review of its organizational structure and workforce […]

item.title: Inventory destocking drives down Canadian GDP this quarter
item.description: Temporary, non-tariff-related distortions also weighed on Q4 growth, including labour disruptions in education and postal service.

item.title: North Bay tech firm creates app to 'revolutionize grocery shopping'
item.description: Local company, One Red Maple, has released their new app, Gofer.run, which compares grocery prices between multiple stores.

item.title: North Bay man arrested with drugs, cash, ammunition and brass knuckles all being seized
item.description: Drug trafficking charges laid after search warrant executed at a Regina Street residence

item.title: Powassan Voodoos win big over the Greater Sudbury Cubs on Friday night
item.description: The Voodoos outlasted the Cubs in a very rough contest Friday night at the Powassan Sportsplex with Caleb Dawson having a four-point night
